rule_text.name: 701.84a
rule_text.rule: To substantiate a card, put it onto the battlefield face down under your control as a 2/2 face-down creature card with no text, no name, no subtypes, and no mana cost. That permanent is a substantiated permanent as long as it remains face down. The effect defining its characteristics works while the card is face down and ends when it’s turned face up.

rule_text.name: 701.84b
rule_text.rule: Any time you have priority, you may exile and cast a substantiated permanent you control face up. This is a special action that doesn’t use the stack (see rule 116.2b). To do this, show all players that the card representing that permanent is a noncreature card, then cast that card. You still pay its costs, but this is not an alternate cost, so alternate costs can be paid. The effect defining its characteristics while it was face down ends, and it regains its normal characteristics. (If the card representing that permanent is a creature card, it doesn’t have a mana cost, or you are unable to cast it, it can’t be turned face up this way.)

subrules.rule: To add a card to your evil plan, look at the card, then exile it face down. Cards exiled this way are “in your evil plan.”

subrules.name: 701.103b
subrules.rule: A player may look at the cards exiled in their evil plan.

subrules.name: 701.103c
subrules.rule: Once each turn, a player may pay {7} as a sorcery to cast any of the cards in their evil plan without paying their mana costs. This is a special action. See rule 116.2a.

rule_only_entries.reason: The formal rule grants every player an unconditional global once-per-turn sorcery-speed paid special action that casts any number of plan cards without paying their mana costs. This is an intrinsic new game rule under the confirmed scope, including empty-plan availability and the shared per-player quota; a source-installed or activated-ability approximation is not equivalent.
